item.title: Santosh Kunwar Elected President of NRNA Australia
item.description: Santosh Kunwar has been elected as the President of the Non-Resident Nepali Association (NRNA) Australia. According to the election commission, Kunwar secured a total of 6,839 votes to claim victory.
